rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); the SkSL chart composer behind Canvas::draw_sdf_shape_with_shader now derives PulpChart for ring, flat_segment, rounded_segment and stadium as well as flat_arc, each matching the geometry draw_sdf_shape draws for the same style, and sdf_chart::shape_has_chart admits them; quadratic_bezier, arc and the filled shapes stay refused by name. PulpChart gains two trailing fields, cross (signed offset from the centre line along the normal (tan.y, -tan.x)) and halfWidth; t, d, side, tan, px and valid keep their meaning. The flat arc's d now includes its flat caps, so a chart shader that masks by d stops painting the part of the ring outside the sweep; pixels inside the sweep are unchanged. The chart feather now scales the whole premultiplied colour instead of alpha alone, so a feathered chart's falloff no longer composites brighter than its alpha; unfeathered charts are unchanged. The Canvas::draw_sdf_shape_with_shader doc comment names the charted shapes and the new fields. No design-import, Chromium, packaging or authority boundary moves; the Pulp canvas target has not adopted a Vellum package.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart feather keeps the colour premultiplied'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart refuses and names every shape it cannot chart'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart: degenerate bands report valid = 0'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart: ring and flat arc chart t around and cross radially'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart: segments and stadium chart t along and cross across'
